hero.caption: A parking lot at 600 Juliana Street (Template:West Virginia Route 14) in Parkersburg, West Virginia, United States.  This was formerly the location of the Peter G. Van Winkle House; built in 1880 and listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1982, it has been demolished but has not yet been de-designated.
